summary.text: James Ohrenschall is a Democratic state senator from Nevada who has represented District 21 since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; he is an attorney who earlier served in the Nevada State Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Ohrenschall earned a B.A. in economics and a J.D. from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, and his professional experience includes working as an attorney.
He represented Assembly District 12 from 2006 to 2018 and assumed his Senate seat on November 7, 2018.

In the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Senate Legislative Operations and Elections Committee, vice chair of the Senate Government Affairs Committee and a member of the Senate Judiciary Committee.
